code.description: The error code (an `ErrorCode` name), always present: the key clients branch on.

detail.description: An explanation of this occurrence; a 5xx never describes the failure.

errorId.description: 5xx only: the identifier of the error in the server log.

csrfHeader.description: The value of the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie, required on every state-changing request (POST, PUT, DELETE), sign-in included, unless the session token is sent in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
csrfHeader.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN

sessionCookie.description: The session JWT, set by `POST /api/1.0/session` (HttpOnly cookie). API clients may send the same token in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
sessionCookie.name: session

info.description: REST API of the Erasmus Management Application (EMA): sign-in, users, mobility choices, mobilities, partners and reference data. Sign in with `POST /api/1.0/session`: the response sets the `session` cookie, which the browser then sends with every call. State-changing requests also need the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header, holding the value of the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`, schema `ProblemDetail`), localized from `Accept-Language` (fr, en).
info.title: Erasmus Management Application API
